mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refresh_sessions WHERE token_hash=#{hash} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_sessions SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
